summary: Full e2e testing (backend + frontend) of Simulation Sandbox Phase 1. All 22 backend pytest cases pass (run lifecycle, causal inspection, interventions, replay/determinism). Frontend Playwright testing confirmed: run creation, Play/Pause/Step/Speed autoplay, precise pixel-accurate entity click-to-select (computed via API state + tile math), Entity Inspector showing REAL candidate scores/rejected goals/decision explanation/accepted action/rejected proposals/causal chain (not placeholders), deselect-on-empty-click, Events tab row-click-to-select, Rejections tab with real reason codes (conflict.resource_contention), Determinism tab Verify Replay (pass, verified_ticks=24) and Verify Determinism (pass, matching final_state_hash) after 24+ ticks, Interventions tab boost_need/spawn_tree/kill_entity all accepted with visible canvas state change (dead entity rendered with X mark). Day/night phase label and shelter square-outline rendering also confirmed on canvas after ~25-30 ticks.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py causal chain walk-back only follows parents[0] (first causal parent) - acceptable for linear chains but if an event ever has multiple causal parents, only one branch is shown; not a bug for current domains since none appear to produce multi-parent events yet.

InterventionsPanel error handling references e?.response?.data?.detail which assumes an axios-style error shape; verified working correctly for the 400 invalid-type case via API, but should double check api.js's HTTP client actually throws with that shape (not explicitly tested but no errors observed in UI during testing).
Code is clean, well-organized, domains correctly proposal-only, Core commit pipeline correctly gates all mutations - no violations of the non-negotiable doctrine observed.
test_credentials: None required - no auth in app
seed_data_creation: Created several ephemeral runs via API/UI during testing (seeds: TEST_seed_pytest, playwright_test_seed, click_test_seed_2, deselect_test_seed, tabs_test_seed, intervene_ui_seed) - these are harmless leftover documents in kernel_runs/entities collections, no cleanup endpoint exists so left as-is (single-user local sandbox tool, not production data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This was the first full test pass on a greenfield build. Everything requested in the review passed: canvas rendering (terrain/trees/people/animals/shelters), autoplay controls, precise entity click-to-select (used API state + tile-size 26px math + canvas bounding_box to compute exact pixel targets - this technique works reliably and should be reused for any future entity-click testing), all 5 inspector tabs, causal inspection with genuine non-fabricated data (verified candidate scores sum sensibly, rejected proposals have real reason codes like conflict.resource_contention, causal chain walks back through real parent event ids), interventions (all 3 types accepted end-to-end with visible canvas effects), and both replay verify + determinism verify pass with real hash comparisons. No bugs found. No action items for main agent.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this pass.
